executiveSummary: Multiple perimeter-edge exploits are active against widely deployed remote access gateways, with credible pathways to enterprise compromise and IT-to-OT pivot. Several new or newly spotlighted OT product vulnerabilities increase the risk of device takeover or network disruption if unpatched and insufficiently segmented. Intelligence also indicates sustained, state-linked intrusion activity against critical infrastructure and mass exploitation of enterprise applications with potential supply-chain and operations impacts. Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway vulnerabilities (including CVE-2026-88771/88772/88779) are being actively exploited, enabling initial access and persistence on remote access infrastructure. Immediate patching and compromise assessment are required. Security Advisory CISA KEV F5 BIG-IP APM (OAuth Authorization Server) unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-94127) is confirmed in the wild, threatening remote access pathways frequently used to broker OT access. Security Advisory Red Lion Controls N-Tron 700 Series switches contain critical flaws allowing unauthenticated administrative actions, firmware tampering, and reboot DoS-risking OT network stability. ICS Advisory Advantech OT gateways face multiple high-severity issues: WISE-6610 command injections with public exploits and EKI-1242 series unauthenticated/missing-auth critical functions-both enabling device takeover. View Article Supporting Report Joint advisory attributes sustained critical-infrastructure targeting to PRC-linked operators enabled by Integrity Technology Group, combining automated scanning, VPN/proxy infrastructure, and living-off-the-land methods; immediate hardening and hunting are advised. Security Advisory ShinyHunters are mass-exploiting Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) with WAF-evasion techniques, impacting government and aviation-adjacent entities, raising supply-chain and operational risk. View Article CISA ICS advisories for openPDC/openHistorian (STTP publisher unauthenticated access) and Satel Netco Design (XSS/path traversal) warrant prompt upgrades and segmentation. Supporting Report Supporting Report Actively exploited Fortinet FortiMail path traversal (CVE-2026-104286) and Zammad helpdesk flaws were added to CISA KEV-prioritize patching and compromise checks. CISA KEV CISA KEV Widespread direct internet exposure of European wind/solar OT admin interfaces increases the likelihood of unauthorized control actions; remove from the internet immediately. items: PRC-linked operations enabled by Integrity Technology Group: identity attacks, VPN persistence, XSS credential theft; cross-sector CI impacts. Security Advisory
ShinyHunters mass-exploiting Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) with WAF-evasion; targets include government and aviation-adjacent entities. View Article
macOS "MacSync" stealer/backdoor targets developer endpoints, creating supply-chain risk for CI vendors and operators. View Article
Windows "MovieReaper" torrent-delivered malware with Solana-resolved C2; enterprise footholds may precede lateral movement into OT-adjacent networks. View Article
Ransomware operators abusing Active Directory GPO to disrupt enterprises; technique can affect domain-joined HMIs/engineering workstations. View Article

relevance: - Edge access gateways (NetScaler, F5 APM, FortiMail) frequently mediate remote operations and vendor access; compromise provides a direct route toward engineering workstations and jump servers. - OT network gear (Red Lion N-Tron) and field gateways (Advantech) sit on process-critical segments; unauthenticated changes or firmware tampering can disrupt control loops or blind monitoring. - State-linked intrusion activity and mass exploitation (PeopleSoft) increase the chance of supplier or enterprise pivots into OT if segmentation is weak or shared identity is reused. - New ICS advisories (openPDC/openHistorian, Satel Netco) emphasize legacy config risks and need for strict network ACLs and authentication on telemetry pipelines and management UIs.

items: Red Lion Controls N-Tron 700 Series: unauthenticated SNMP/TFTP/firmware actions; upgrade to 3.11.1+, restrict management services. ICS Advisory
Advantech WISE-6610: command injection with public exploits; update to fixed firmware and lock down admin services. View Article
Advantech EKI-1242 series: multiple critical issues including missing-auth on critical functions. View Article
openPDC/openHistorian (STTP): unauthenticated publisher defaults enable remote telemetry exchange; update and bind to loopback/restricted interfaces. ICS Advisory
Satel Netco Design: stored XSS, ReDoS, path traversal (possible RCE under conditions); update to 2.1.7 and restrict UI exposure. ICS Advisory
F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth AS (CVE-2026-94127): unauth RCE; hotfix/iRule mitigations available. Security Advisory
Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway: active RCE/DoS exploitation; patch and hunt with IOCs. Security Advisory
FortiMail (CVE-2026-104286): path traversal added to KEV; patch and assess for compromise. CISA KEV
Ollama model server: unauthenticated RCE; update to 0.35.0 and restrict API access. Security Advisory

outlook72h: Watch for spike in exploit traffic toward NetScaler and F5 APM; preemptively geofence and rate-limit while patching and rotating credentials. Audit OT management subnets for exposed SNMP/TFTP/HTTP and remediate Red Lion/Advantech device configurations; deploy network telemetry for SNMP set/firmware transfers. Run threat hunts for PRC-linked TTPs (password spraying, OAuth token misuse, VPN client persistence) across email and identity systems; block known proxy infra where possible. Security Advisory Validate PeopleSoft exposure and WAF normalization rules (URL decoding) against current exploitation techniques; review large data egress from HR/benefits stores. View Article Confirm removal of any direct internet exposure of renewable OT admin portals; coordinate with national CERTs as needed. View Article ESCALATE MONITOR IGNORE
